description: How much the user can spend right now without breaking their forecast: a one-off amount, an extra monthly amount and a daily amount until the next expected income (spending.daily: amount, days, until; untilIncome=false means until the 1st of next month), with and without touching their emergency cushion (cushion_months of essential spending, 3 by default as in the app). Computed by Cuéntamo over the full 5-year horizon, also on the free plan. If the balance is forecast to go negative, says so (free plan: only roughly when, in years). Month values may be "now", "later" (beyond the free plan window) or null (not within the forecast).

book.description: Account book id (from list_books). Optional if the user has only one.

cushion_months.description: Months of essential spending to keep as emergency cushion (default 3).

name: how_much_can_i_spend
title: How much can I spend?
